Veyra Help & Contact

A quiet place for the moments that matter.

Something not working, or a question about Veyra? Write to us at veyra.memories@gmail.com and we'll get back to you. It helps if you say which phone you use and what happened.

Common questions

I forgot my password

On the sign-in page, tap "Forgot your password?" and enter your email. We'll send you a link to choose a new one. Open it on the same phone.

My sign-up code didn't arrive

Check your spam or junk folder, then tap "Resend code". If you already have a Veyra account with that email, sign in instead.

How do I download everything I've kept?

Profile → "Your memories are yours" → Download my memories. You get a zip with your moments, letters and photos.

How do I delete my account?

Profile → Delete account. Everything is deleted: your account, moments, letters, adventures and photos. It can't be undone, so download your memories first if you want to keep them.

How do I cancel my subscription?

Subscriptions are handled by Apple. On your iPhone: Settings → your name → Subscriptions → Veyra. Cancel at least a day before it renews. Deleting the app or your account doesn't cancel it on its own.

I got a new phone and my subscription is gone

Sign in with the same account, open the subscription page and tap "Restore purchases".
